caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an old-fashioned kettle, centered on the page. The kettle is rendered in shades of gray using fine stippling or shading techniques, giving it a metallic appearance. It features a rounded body with a slightly flattened base, a prominent curved spout on the left, and a domed lid with a small knob on top, placed in the center of the upper surface. Attached to the body on both sides is an arching, thick handle that rises above the lid, secured with prominent, rounded hinges. The background is plain with a lightly shaded rectangular border framing the image. The overall color scheme is monochromatic, utilizing only black and shades of gray on a beige or off-white paper. There is a signature in the bottom right corner outside the drawing area.
title: Kettle
